dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、思わぬ出費が出てしまった」
dialogues.en: "Sigh, more money out the window."
dialogues.text: "Sigh, more money out the window."

dialogues.jp: 風呂に入ったあと、ベッドに寝転がる。
dialogues.en: Straight out from the bath, I flop down onto my bed.
dialogues.text: Straight out from the bath, I flop down onto my bed.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、外食しようが実際はコンビニとそれほど
変わらないのだが……それに、今日は悪いこと
ばかりでは無かった。
dialogues.en:
At least we just ate from a convenience store as usual...
and today wasn't entirely bad either.
dialogues.text:
At least we just ate from a convenience store as usual...
and today wasn't entirely bad either.

dialogues.jp: 特に、ことりと出会えたのは幸運だった。
dialogues.en: It was a real stroke of luck that I met Kotori again.
dialogues.text: It was a real stroke of luck that I met Kotori again.

dialogues.jp:
このことに比べたら、小食の音夢の食事代など、
取るに足りないものだ。
dialogues.en:
And Nemu never eats much anyway, so it didn't end up costing
that much.
dialogues.text:
And Nemu never eats much anyway, so it didn't end up costing
that much.

dialogues.jp: まあ、目覚ましもくれたし。
dialogues.en: Which just leaves that alarm clock.
dialogues.text: Which just leaves that alarm clock.

dialogues.jp: 枕元の球体を掴む。
dialogues.en: I grab the spherical thing at my bedside.
dialogues.text: I grab the spherical thing at my bedside.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢、ガムテープってどこにあるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu, where do we keep the packing tape?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu, where do we keep the packing tape?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そこの引き出しにあるけど」
dialogues.en: "Eh? It should be in that drawer."
dialogues.text: "Eh? It should be in that drawer."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の指す引出しを見ると、確かにガムテープ
があった。
dialogues.en:
Following Nemu's directions, I quickly find the packing
tape.
dialogues.text:
Following Nemu's directions, I quickly find the packing
tape.

dialogues.jp: 「サンキュー」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.jp:
ガムテープの輪に手首を通し、回転させながら
部屋に戻る。
dialogues.en:
Wearing the packing tape around my wrist like a ring, I
twirled it around my arm as I returned to my room.
dialogues.text:
Wearing the packing tape around my wrist like a ring, I
twirled it around my arm as I returned to my room.

dialogues.jp: 「……これでよし、と」
dialogues.en: "...This should do it."
dialogues.text: "...This should do it."

dialogues.jp: 球体をガムテープでベッドに貼り付ける。
dialogues.en:
I had used the packing tape to stick the ball-thing onto the
bed.
dialogues.text:
I had used the packing tape to stick the ball-thing onto the
bed.

dialogues.jp: 「フッ……拘束してしまえばこっちのものよ」
dialogues.en:
"Heh... let's see how far away you'd get with this holding
you back."
dialogues.text:
"Heh... let's see how far away you'd get with this holding
you back."

dialogues.jp: ベッドの上でほくそ笑む俺。
dialogues.en: I grinned and got back onto my bed.
dialogues.text: I grinned and got back onto my bed.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、時間ぐらいはセットしておくか」
dialogues.en: "Well, better set the alarm."
dialogues.text: "Well, better set the alarm."

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: ***After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: ***After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: ***After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: ***After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: ***After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: ***After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp: ◆ガムテープと目覚まし時計◆
dialogues.en: ◆Packing Tape + Alarm Clock◆
dialogues.text: ◆Packing Tape + Alarm Clock◆

dialogues.jp:
球体の目覚まし時計を、ガムテープで拘束した。
固定してしまえば、こっちのものってところだ。
dialogues.en:
I restrained the spherical alarm clock to the bed using
packing tape. Making sure that it won't be able to run away
so easily.
dialogues.text:
I restrained the spherical alarm clock to the bed using
packing tape. Making sure that it won't be able to run away
so easily.
